scenarios.title: Level 6 hero with 25 stat and 5 skill points banked: the bot spends none of them
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 6 with the points a played level gives (debug stat 12, statpts, skillpts). Reachable by play.
scenarios.notes: The default of the product: the player decides every point (ADR 0020). The knob is set to its default explicitly so a measured-run environment (D2BOT_RUN) cannot flip it.

assert.why: no stat point was spent behind the player's back
no skill point was spent behind the player's back

scenarios.title: Autopilot on: every banked stat and skill point is spent through the d2d verbs
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level 6 with the points a played level gives. Reachable by play.
scenarios.notes: pointsDecisions 1 is the same switch as a hero's autopilot, so the leveler plans from its table and spends by `cmd stat` and `cmd skillpt` (read back by the leveler; a failed verb falls back to clicks, which a headless d2d cannot do, so a stuck run shows as unspent points). The skill rows of the shipped tables at clvl 6 are legal under d2d's can_learn.

assert.why: the stat points were taken
the skill points were taken
the dump shows skill points in the tree
